title: 鉄筋コンクリート工学
subtitle: Reinforced Concrete Engineering
keywords: Reinforced Concrete 2.Behavior of RC Beams 3.Shear Behavior of RC 4.Design Methods for RC 5.Prestressed Concrete
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) Understand the principles and features of reinforced concrete. (2) Master the basic theory of behavior of reinforced concrete subjected to bending and shearing. (3) Understand the design method of reinforced concrete and the principle and characteristics of prestressed concrete.
advice: This is a basic course on construction materials. We will cover the following topics: 1. Principles and features of reinforced concrete, properties of constituent materials, conditions and structural details for reinforced concrete. 2. Behavior of reinforced concrete beams subjected to bending 3. Behavior of reinforced concrete beams subjected to shear 4. Design methods for reinforced concrete 5. Principles and features of prestressed concrete Students are required to actively participate in class. Students are expected to bring their textbook and other necessary materials to every class. This is useful preparation for lectures on Disaster Prevention Engineering and Civil and Environmental Engineering Major Lab/Exercises.

activityGoals.body: Students will understand the principles of reinforced concrete and the features of various design methods.[0.1J]
Students can use the ultimate strength design method to calculate member strengths. [0.3J]
Students can use the design method of reinforced concrete. [0.2J]
Students can explain the roles and features of steel and asphalt. [0.3J]
Students can explain the principles and features of prestressed concrete. [0.1J]

lessons.content: Guidance - Acquaint students with the subject. - Students understand the topic's relationships to other subjects. Introduction - Inform students that course topics may extend beyond listed materials. Reinforced concrete ・Principles and features of reinforced concrete ・ Cracks generated in various locations ・ Reinforcing bar placement and role ・ Structural details
lessons.assignments: Review reinforced concrete. Prepare for basic lecture on mechanics.

lessons.content: Basic lecture on mechanics ・ Force and stress ・ Deformation and strain Material properties ・ Mechanical properties of concrete ・ Mechanical properties of reinforcing bars ・ Behavior of reinforced concrete members subjected to bending
lessons.assignments: Review 1st and 2nd classes. Prepare for Behavior of members subjected to bending (1).

lessons.content: Outline of cement concrete Quiz [1] (15%) - 1st and 2nd classes Behavior of reinforced concrete members subjected to bending
lessons.assignments: Review for Quiz [1]. Prepare for Behavior of members subjected to bending (1).

lessons.content: Behavior of members subjected to bending (1) ・ Behavior of reinforced concrete beams subjected to bending ・ Stress level of the cross-section after cracking
lessons.assignments: Review for Behavior of members subjected to bending (1). Prepare for Behavior of members subjected to bending (2).

lessons.content: Behavior of members subjected to bending (2) ・ Ultimate bending moment of section ・ Bending tensile failure and bending compression failure
lessons.assignments: Review of Behavior of members subjected to bending (2). Prepare for Behavior of members subjected to bending (3)

lessons.content: Behavior of members subjected to bending (3) ・ Deformation of members subjected to bending ・ Deflection of beam members subjected to Bending
lessons.assignments: Review of 3rd-6th classes. Prepare for Adhesion and cracking.
Review for Quiz [2]. Prepare for Adhesion and cracking.

lessons.content: Adhesion and cracking ・ Adhesion of concrete and rebar ・ Cracking due to bending ・ Cracks and steel corrosion
lessons.assignments: Review Adhesion and cracking. Prepare for Behavior of members subjected to shear (1).

lessons.content: Adhesion and cracking ・ Adhesion of concrete and rebar ・ Cracking due to bending ・ Cracks and steel corrosion Behavior of members subjected to shear (1) ・ Shear failure ・ Types and roles of shear reinforcement

lessons.assignments: Review of Behavior of members subjected to shear (2).

lessons.assignments: Review 7th-10th classes. Preparation for Prestressed concrete.
